title: Why building an effective sales pipeline takes time

the-obvious-objection.title: The obvious objection
the-obvious-objection.script: So the obvious objection: I start selling in January, and the April revenue lands in March? It does not work like a switch.

the-claim.title: The claim
the-claim.script: A pipeline is built, measured and tuned, and that takes months. Three words describe it: funnel, conversion rate and sales cycle.
